description: This file defines a custom implementation of CookieAuthenticationEvents for handling user authentication validation in an ASP.NET Core web application. It overrides the ValidatePrincipal method to implement token revocation logic using an in-memory cache.

classes.name: RevokeAuthenticationEvents
classes.description: A custom authentication event handler that revokes user sessions based on cache entries, extending CookieAuthenticationEvents.

methods.name: RevokeAuthenticationEvents
methods.description: Constructor that initializes cache and logger dependencies.

methods.name: ValidatePrincipal
methods.description: Overrides the method to validate whether the user's authentication principal should be accepted or revoked, based on cache entries.
